notes.title: Madnight 2025 Has Ended – Now the Hellish wait begins!
notes.notes:
[b]The World of Agony[/b] is growing! 

Dear fans! We are pleased to announce that our universe, connecting all the games we produce, is growing even more, thanks to the Tormentor, in which you will find a lot of references to Agony, [b]Succubus[/b] or Paranoid. 

But that's not all. During Madnight 2025, we answered your questions about Sirens, Lust of God, Agony: Lords of Hell and we revealed many details about these productions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/0936d867be95b03d0ed6aec5c258f768ff28f8ff.jpg[/img]


Madnight 2025 is over, and what a night it was. 59 minutes of pure, unfiltered horror, a deep dive into Tormentor, a fight against censorship, and surprises that left our audience speechless. But this is just the beginning.

Now, Tormentor is officially on [b]Kickstarter[/b]. If you want this game to be as brutal, raw, and uncompromising as we envision, we need your support.

👉 [i][b]Follow and Back Tormentor, now on Kickstarter:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


[h2]Madnight 2025 – The Highlights[/h2]

🔴 [b]A Night of Madness[/b]
We kicked things off with a live-action sequence starring the Madmind himself, Tomek, who delivered a bone-chilling manifesto on the struggles of bringing this art form to you, the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/e9f573d0b625eafe34e9ba97e1b2da6762cbcee4.jpg[/img]You can watch it here: [url=https://youtu.be/cNs-Bfbd9CE?t=93][b]1:34[/b][/url]


🩸 [b]Tormentor Gameplay Demo & Deep Dive[/b]
For the first time, we gave a full gameplay walkthrough, exploring the main hub, showcasing mechanics, and revealing just how deep the depravity goes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cNs-Bfbd9CE&t=628

🎥 [b]Developer Interviews[/b]
The masterminds behind Tormentor joined us for exclusive interviews, revealing details and their vision for the many aspects of gameplay in Tormentor.

🔪 [b]Surprise Reveals & Teasers[/b]
We unveiled the Equinox Club update for Nymphomaniac and dropped a teaser for a mysterious new character, sending shockwaves through our community on Discord.

[h3]⚡ The Biggest Premiere in Our History[/h3]
To close the night, we made our biggest announcement yet, something that will shape the future of our studio. If you missed it, you’ll want to go back and watch it.

[previewyoutube=fdBuOCfpI5E;full]https://youtu.be/fdBuOCfpI5E[/previewyoutube]

[b]🤝 Now, It’s Your Turn – Support Tormentor[/b]

Madnight 2025 may be over, but the real fight begins now. We’re pushing boundaries, standing against censorship, and creating something truly uncompromising. If you want Tormentor to reach its full potential, we need your support on Kickstarter.

🔥[i][b] Follow and Back Tormentor when the Kickstarter launches:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


Thank you to everyone who joined us for Madnight 2025. Now, let’s bring this nightmare to life.

[b]Wishlist Tormentor and Join the Community server![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/

notes.title: Agony: Lords of Hell - Demo available now!
notes.notes:
Hello, Martyrs!

We are pleased to announce that we're releasing the Agony: Lords of Hell demo on Steam, which will remain active until the end of the Kickstarter campaign. The demo contains a fragment of the game, in Alpha version 0.666 and is available globally, for [b]all Steam users - not just for Kickstarter backers[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493430/Agony_Lords_of_Hell/

We invite you to play through and complete the feedback survey present in the demo. Based on the collected answers, we'll be able to better tailor the game to the expectations of you, the players. 

The completely different visions of Hell, which can be found in the books of individual Religions, will require the preparation of many assets, unique mechanics for each of the "factions", dozens of new characters and beautiful scenery. To achieve our vision, we need your support!

Thanks to the Kickstarter campaign, we will not only be able to fulfill our ambitious plans, but also enable players to decide how big and how extensive the Agony Lords of Hell project will be. 

The game is powered by [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b], supporting all the latest technologies, including the destruction of the environment based on the "Chaos" technology, a dynamic day and night system, the Niagara system and many more.

[b]We hope you enjoy the demo, and look forward to seeing you in hell![/b]

notes.title: AGONY: Lords of Hell
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Martyrs,[/b]

[b]AGONY: Lords of Hell[/b] is a new title from the World of Agony, for which the newly created internal team of Madmind Studio - Team Alpha is responsible. The team's task, apart from producing the new game, will also be supporting Succubus in the form of free updates and paid DLC in 2022.

Agony and Agony UNRATED have already reached almost 800,000 players around the world. The players’ appreciation prompted us to release Succubus, a game that was set in the Agony universe, continuing and developing some of the plot and lore. Agony: Lords of Hell [b]shows the events that took place between Agony and Succubus[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/8d24d7b67f23532297322dfef89f9d9efb39bdd1.jpg[/img]

The story of the game will tell about the fate of the main characters of Agony and Succubus - king Nimrod and Vydija, a demonic succubus. With the departure of the rightful rulers of Hell, [b]a war for the throne broke out[/b]. The lords of hell, ruling over different lands, begin to gather armies of demons to slay the rulers who threatened them. Our heroes will be forced not only to maintain their current position, but also to expand their empire and conquer the enemy territories.

The main inspiration for the gameplay in Agony: Lords of Hell is the iconic Populous series. While the main character of the game - Nimrod, will focus on developing the city and managing the army, the demonic Vydijia will become the main unit controlled by the player. With numerous combat skills and special powers, Vydija will lead Nimrod's army to victory, and will be the key strategic element of every battle. Thanks to her high position among other succubi, Vydija will use her abilities to seduce and then incorporate martyrs, who do not belong to any of the factions, into her own army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/f04f463a66365acc5ded0b7418eff49179f646f8.jpg[/img]

Similar to Agony, we want players to be able to decide about the scale of Agony: Lords of Hell project. In 2022, players from around the world will be able to support this ambitious project using the Kickstarter crowdfunding platform. During the planned crowdfundning, players will decide how extensive Agony: Lords of Hell will be. A demo version of the game will be available to players supporting the game, which will allow them to get to know its unique world, full of dangers, horrors and ... Strategy!

The first trailer of the game will be presented [b]on December 16, 2021, during MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase[/b].

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Madmind Studio

notes.title: MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players[/b],

We would like to invite you to the video presentation organized together with Rely On Horror - "MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase", during which new materials from the widely understood horror games produced by Madmind Studio will be presented, with guest participation of developers from other studios.

MADNIGHT 2021: The Horror Showcase takes place [b]December 16, 2021[/b].

The entire event will be available at [url=www.relyonhorror.com]www.relyonhorror.com[/url] - one of the largest, most popular websites focused on horror games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/d92e8046f12eb649c01404242936cde9a3529667.jpg[/img]

MADNIGHT 2021 is [b]an event unprecedented in the gaming industry[/b], during which players will be able to get to meet the Hell Messenger for the first time - a mysterious creature with which they have been interacting for many months on our social media and Madmind Studio's Discord channel.

[b]The Hell Messenger[/b] will take viewers into a terrifying world of horror that can take many forms. Have you ever wondered what working in a crematorium looks like? What does a person with advanced paranoid schizophrenia feel and see? Or maybe you want an extreme dose of uncompromising brutality and gore? You will see all these and many other attractions soon during MADNIGHT 2021!

[b]MADNIGHT 2021 Horror Showcase will feature[/b]:

- Madmind Studio
- Black Rat
- Live Motion Games
- Lunarium Creations
- IGNIBIT
- Woodland Games

Over the past five years, Madmind Studio has become synonymous with frightening, controversial and violent games. This year's premiere of the studio's latest game, Succubus, [b]was very well received by players and critics[/b] who decided to give the game very positive recommendations.

In addition to good grades, [b]Succubus achieved great financial results[/b]. Released on October 5 2021, the game has so far made more money on Steam than the studio's previous game, Agony, in more than three years since its release.

“Succubus, announced back in 2018, after almost three full years of production, has finally been released. We wanted the game to be able to defend itself with the quality of workmanship and an original, previously unheard of in video games, dose of uncensored brutality on the day of its premiere. We are looking forward to the premiere of the first Succubus DLC, which will be released during MADNIGHT 2021 ”- [b]Madmind Studio[/b].

See you soon!
 
[url=www.relyonhorror.com]www.relyonhorror.com[/url]
[url=www.madmind-studio.com]www.madmind-studio.com[/url]

[previewyoutube=z1Y0jYP1NlU;full][/previewyoutube]

Succubus is meant to present the game world from the perspective of [b]a liberated demon[/b] who is indifferent to such human qualities as shame or shyness. The main character of the game - Vydija, leaves not only a sea of dismembered and mutilated victims on her way, but also [b]finds time to satisfy her own needs[/b].

[b]CUSTOMIZATION[/b]

Customization is an important element of the game, and will allow players to [b]customize the appearance of the main character, her armor and powers, and above all - her cave[/b], which acts as the Main Hub of the game. During the playthrough, players will gain the souls of slain enemies, which are a currency in Succubus. You will also be able to [b]unlock new parts and buy new weapons, armor and special powers[/b] with this currency.

[olist]
[*] Change in the appearance of the main character, including her facial features and skin color.
[*] Customize armor and special powers that affect the gameplay.

[/olist]

notes.title: SUCCUBUS Story Trailer and a new Release Date
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

We come to you with the new trailer and to explain why we have decided to postpone the game until [b]October 5, 2021[/b]. The reason for postponing the release date is the need to fine-tune the game and bug fixing. To make sure that the you all get [b]a bug-free and well-optimized production[/b], we have decided to perform additional external tests and consulted the reviewers of well-known gaming services who completed the game and shared their thoughts and suggestions with us. We have decided to spend the extra time on [b]introducing a few improvements[/b] that will give the players a better and more satisfying production.

You always say that we need to take our time and that there is no rush and that is why [b]we have decided to take our time[/b]. There is no sense in releasing an unpolished product and we respect you too much to do so.

But we are not leaving you empty-handed. Here is our newest STORY TRAILER:

[previewyoutube=Uf39MT85kyM;full][/previewyoutube]

The key story cutscenes are created by talented animators from Fusion FX and Realtime Warriors, who have made, among others, cutscenes for The Witcher 3 and animations for Cyberpunk 2077. We hope you enjoy it and we appreciate your patience.

[b]Thank You,[/b]
Madmind Studio

notes.title: SUCCUBUS - NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[b]Hell(o),[/b]

We would like to inform you about the change of the release date of Succubus. Initially, the title was supposed to be released in July. However, we have decided to spend more time optimizing and refining the production.

[b]Succubus will be released on PC on September 8, 2021. [/b]

Thanks to [b]the extensive feedback from players[/b] who had the opportunity to check the game during the Steam Next demo festival, we have decided to refine some elements of the game so that our title can meet the high expectations of [b]you - our fans[/b]. We want to release a game with the quality of which we and the players will be satisfied, because [b]you, the players are most important[/b].

Succubus is getting more interest before its launch (based on Steam Wishlist) than our previous game Agony, which [b]sold over 500,000 copies[/b]. We believe that the extra time we have decided to spend on fine-tuning the title will allow us to provide fans with a production that meets their expectations.

The Succubus demo from the beginning to the end of the festival was the most popular and most downloaded demo in the genre of horror games. [b]We want to make it even better[/b]!

Please be patient, we are putting our hearts and souls into this project (plus Vydija is watching)!

[b]Your humble servants,[/b]
Madmind Studio

[b]Tormentor[/b] will be a horror game, which allows players to perform a torturer's role. notes.title: Succubus activates the Fury Mode to rip apart her enemies!
notes.notes:
[b]Hell(o) Martyrs,[/b]

Madmind Studios invites you to watch the latest gameplay teaser from Succubus (Agony spin-off). It presents the [b]Fury Mode[/b], a new addition to the key actions of Vydija, the main protagonist in this Adult Only game:

[previewyoutube=OM46-mdlRo8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]About Fury Mode[/h1]

It is an additional element that enriches the gameplay in Succubus. After killing a certain number of enemies, players can release the heroine's rage, becoming immune to attacks. Using only her claws in a fight, she gains much greater strength, which allows her to defeat most opponents with just one blow. By tearing enemies to pieces in slow motion, Vydija moves much faster than her opponents. It lets her survive clashes even when she's vastly outnumbered. [b]Fury allows players to take a more tactical approach to combat[/b]. Those who can use it wisely at a crucial moment in the fight gain a massive advantage over their opponents.

[b]All the best,[/b]
[i]Madmind Studio[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985830/Succubus/
